Go to Employee Self-Service
First, you must make your way to the Employee Self-Service portal of Banner where you will be prompted to enter your MSU credentials. You can find the Banner Links homepage here .
Job Summary
Click on the drop down arrow next to "Job Summary." Then, click on the "Job Information" link.
Review Salaries by Position
Here, all current and previous positions will be listed. By clicking on the drop down arrows next to each position you can review a salary history from contract inception to date. This is where you can source the salary data for faculty summer contracts.
